## Log file

Attach `notecraft.log` from:

- Windows: `%APPDATA%\NoteCraft\logs\`
- macOS: `~/Library/Application Support/NoteCraft/logs/`
- Linux: `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/notecraft/logs/`

Logs never contain note content. If the bug involves a specific note, attach a minimal `.md` or `.notecraft` file that reproduces it, with any private text removed.
